brief:
Lebanon postponed negotiations with Israel scheduled for Rome, according to Ma'an news agency. The delay affects planned discussions between the two countries mediated by international parties. A follow-up meeting in Washington has been rescheduled.

The postponement comes as indirect talks between Lebanon and Israel continue under international auspices. The negotiations address maritime border demarcation and other disputed issues between the neighboring states.
title: Lebanon postpones Rome talks with Israel, rescheduling Washington meeting
